content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository pulp-platform_common_cells_pr222, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# `stream_arbiter` with priority arbitration inherently violates assertion
When configuring a `stream_arbiter` or `stream_arbiter_flushable` with `ARBITER = "prio"`, it instantiates an `rr_arb_tree` with both the `ExtPrio` and `LockIn` parameters set:
https://github.com/pulp-platform/common_cells/blob/0d67563b6b592549542544f1abc0f43e5d4ee8b4/src/stream_arbiter_flushable.sv#L55-L61
However, this directly violates an assertion in `rr_arb_tree`:
https://github.com/pulp-platform/common_cells/blob/0d67563b6b592549542544f1abc0f43e5d4ee8b4/src/rr_arb_tree.sv#L319
As a result, any priority stream arbiters instantiated inherently cause a fatal assertion violation.

1. Carefully review the issue description and thoroughly analyze the issue to uncover all possible causes.
2. Review the provided code file and identify at least three locations within the file that require inspection or modification to resolve the issue.

Guidelines for Specifying Locations:

<analysis>
The root cause is that when the top‐level stream_arbiter uses ARBITER="prio", it simply forwards that to stream_arbiter_flushable, which in turn unconditionally instantiates rr_arb_tree with both ExtPrio=1 (to request priority) and LockIn=1 (to enable the look‐ahead lock), violating the rr_arb_tree assertion “!(ExtPrio && LockIn)”. To correct this, we need to:

1. Prevent the conflicting parameter combination from ever being passed into rr_arb_tree when ARBITER="prio". This starts at the top–level wrapper (stream_arbiter.sv) where ARBITER is defined and passed through.
2. Update the generate block inside stream_arbiter_flushable.sv to disable LockIn (or ExtPrio) when ARBITER="prio", or to instantiate a simpler priority block instead of rr_arb_tree.
3. Optionally, adjust or gate the assertion in rr_arb_tree.sv so that it either accepts the new combination or reports a more specific error condition.

Below are the three key locations that must be inspected and modified to fully resolve the issue.
